relations: Beatrice（叙述对象）；Roland Loiseau（爱人，小她三岁，芝加哥富家次子）；亡夫 Edward Carver（已死）；Ida/Clara/Bertie（同伴）
numbers: 1876 年初遇；Roland 小她三岁；浴缸木雕四景；毒园四种植物

facts.fact: 亡夫死后你发誓不再嫁——受够了男人控制
facts.anchor: you swore you’d never marry again
facts.verbatim: you swore you’d never marry again

facts.fact: 1876 年降神会初遇（父亲与丈夫死后常去 Richmond 茶室后的降神会）
facts.anchor: You first encountered each other at a séance in 1876.
facts.verbatim: You first encountered each other at a séance in 1876.

facts.fact: 灵媒召灵时你睁眼，扫过祈祷人群，目光落在他身上——他正回望你
facts.anchor: until your gaze fell on him, staring back at you
facts.verbatim: until your gaze fell on him, staring back at you

facts.fact: Roland 小你三岁、芝加哥富家次子、法国受教育；玉米色头发、龙卷风般的黑眼
facts.anchor: Three years your junior, Roland Loiseau
facts.verbatim: Three years your junior, Roland Loiseau

facts.fact: 蜘蛛般的大手（传记作者猜曾绕喉咙）、孩子魅力、倦怠笑、爱毛皮与蛋糕、谈死亡如挚友
facts.anchor: they’d been once or twice wrapped around a throat
facts.verbatim: they’d been once or twice wrapped around a throat

facts.fact: 散场时他手挽你臂低语「真可惜，我还想看更多戏」
facts.anchor: I was hoping for a little more theater!
facts.verbatim: I was hoping for a little more theater!

facts.fact: 次晨一盒小啮齿类头骨送到门口，手书标签（Mus musculus / Microtus arvalis / Ondatra zibethicus）——至今仍在档案馆
facts.anchor: a collection of small rodent skulls had arrived at your door
facts.verbatim: a collection of small rodent skulls had arrived at your door

facts.fact: 你逃离弗吉尼亚时，他是你保留的少数「财产」之一
facts.anchor: one of the few possessions you kept
facts.verbatim: one of the few possessions you kept

facts.fact: 学院建成后他应召而来；疑病症、不育（童年腮腺炎）；爱每日矿泉浴
facts.anchor: infertile after a childhood bout of mumps
facts.verbatim: infertile after a childhood bout of mumps

facts.fact: 树篱迷宫 + 中心毒药花园（乌头/Gympie/颠茄/大猪草）；园艺原是亡夫赞许的爱好
facts.anchor: a new garden of poisons for you
facts.verbatim: a new garden of poisons for you

facts.fact: Hogscald 岩腔「教堂」：Roland 在岩讲道坛后诵读（可能是你写的诗）
facts.anchor: Roland stood behind the rock pulpit and recited
facts.verbatim: Roland stood behind the rock pulpit and recited

facts.fact: 你曾发誓不嫁，却向他盟誓 troth；「永不分离」，且确实直到生命尽头
